## API setup — your steps

1. **Get a key:** console.anthropic.com → Settings → API keys → Create key (`sk-ant-...`).
2. **Put it in a file** (don't paste it in chat). In PowerShell via the `!` prefix:

## Options that work with this project

MEMO's wire format is either Anthropic or OpenAI-style `chat/completions`. Everything below speaks the OpenAI format, so it plugs in with a config change and no code change.

**Your actual workload** (measured from the dry-run just now): ~1,200 input + ~500 output tokens per call, ~1 call per coding session.

| Provider | Model | Card needed? | Cost per call | ~100 calls (a heavy month) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Google AI Studio** (Gemini) | `gemini-2.5-flash-lite` | No | $0.00032 (free tier: **$0**) | **$0.03** or free |
| Google AI Studio | `gemini-3.1-flash-lite` | No | $0.00105 (free tier: $0) | $0.11 or free |
| **Groq** | `openai/gpt-oss-20b` | No (free tier) | $0.00024 | $0.02 |
| Groq | `openai/gpt-oss-120b` | No (free tier) | $0.00048 | $0.05 |
| **OpenRouter** | any `:free` model | No | $0 | **$0** (20 req/min, 50/day; 1,000/day after a $10 top-up) |
| **Ollama** (local, your PC) | `qwen3`, `llama3.1` etc. | No | $0 | **$0**, fully offline |
| *(reference)* Anthropic | `claude-haiku-5-5` | Yes | $0.00037 | $0.04 |

So cost was never the problem — Anthropic would also have been ~4 cents a month. The blocker is just account creation, and Gemini/Groq/OpenRouter keys need no card.

**Two things to know before picking:**
- **Free tiers have rate limits, not token limits** — fine here, since MEMO caps at 6 calls per cycle anyway.
- **Privacy:** on free tiers (Gemini especially) the provider may use your data to improve their products. MEMO sends redacted session events — your prompts, tool names, test output. If that matters for this repo, Ollama (local) is the only option that sends nothing anywhere.

My pick: **Gemini `gemini-2.5-flash-lite`** — no card, best free tier, and if you ever exceed it, it's ~3 cents a month.

4 real calls so far — **10,808 in / 4,746 out, total $0.0022** of the $5/month budget. Extraction quality is good: real evidence ids, no dropped items, sensible gaps listed.

**One real limit found:** Groq's free tier allows **8,000 tokens/minute**, and MEMO was sending 12–14k per request → HTTP 413. Fixed by:
- `maxInputTokensPerCall` 12000 → **4000**, `maxCallsPerCycle` 6 → **1** (≈5k tokens per cycle, safely under the limit)
- `src/llm/provider.js` — a 413 that says "tokens per minute" is now **retryable** instead of a permanent job failure (it was killing jobs outright)
